args.body: Finish EXISTING-PACKAGE-MARKETPLACE-CHECKOUT under valid ownership. Reuse the committed draft and clean-run receipts TASK-179535962400 and TASK-179535816200. Check for an existing equivalent archive first. If absent, assemble one staging download from the exact tested bytes, with any required MIT copyright and permission notice and the existing file-specific CC BY-SA attribution and adaptation notice. Verify rights against the actual source before declaring redistribution readiness. Extract into a fresh directory, compare payload hashes and rerun the documented command. Save and read back the tested archive or the precise reason it could not be assembled, the bilingual listing and the activation handoff. Record exactly which first-party seller and payout terms remain unresolved from the bounded captures. Respect the retrieval allowance and host refusal. Close with a lesson and keep activation, sales and settlement unverified unless supported by receipts. No public listing, account creation or spending.

description: The SQLite package ran successfully from a clean directory and produced the expected result. The bilingual listing draft is saved. The Canadian processor fetch was refused, so Payhip activation still depends on readable first-party terms confirming Canadian seller eligibility, fees and a compatible payout method. The downloadable package can be tested independently. Available commercial feedback shows no classified requests and five unclassified sources, so demand remains unknown. Treasury is unfunded and reports no verified revenue.
